Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question and compared the directors’ ages at the time their films were released instead of comparing their birth dates to determine which director is younger overall. Reginald Le Borg (born 1902) is older than Hervé Bromberger (born 1918), so the film with the younger director should be Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là, not Joe Palooka in Fighting Mad.
